title: Juicy Crisp Greek Haricot Beans Saganaki
description: A spicy and crispy Greek dish featuring haricot beans, perfect for a lazy Sunday, this ovo-vegetarian friendly saganaki is a delicious and satisfying meal.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, toss the haricot beans with olive oil, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the bowl and toss until the beans are well combined with the onion and garlic.
Transfer the bean mixture to a grill-safe skillet or saganaki dish.
Top the bean mixture with diced tomato and crumbly feta cheese.
Sprinkle the red pepper flakes over the top of the cheese.
Place the skillet or saganaki dish on the grill and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the beans are crispy.
Remove the skillet or saganaki dish from the grill and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the Juicy Crisp Greek Haricot Beans Saganaki hot, straight from the grill.
